qs.q: A 45-year-old man presents with vertigo and impaired perception of rotational head movements during rapid turns. Which specific structure within the vestibular apparatus contains the receptor cells that detect this form of acceleration?
qs.e: The semicircular canals detect angular acceleration via ampullae containing hair cells that respond to endolymph movement during rotation. The macula of the saccule and utricle are instead involved in detecting linear acceleration and gravity.

qs.q: A patient with severe motion sickness requires a medication that controls vertigo by inhibiting signals from the internal ear to the vomiting center. Which drug is appropriate for this indication?
qs.e: Promethazine acts on firing pathways from the internal ear to the vomiting center to treat motion sickness. Cyproheptadine is used to increase appetite rather than treat motion sickness.
